rootCause: DeviceWallpaper uses cover-art, whose shared detail-page CSS sets position:absolute and inset:0. The thumbnail wrapper did not establish a containing block, so the image was positioned over the entire relative saved-device-item.
changes: Set the saved-device-thumbnail wrapper to position:relative
Override the reused image to position:static and inset:auto inside SavedDeviceList; preserve 100% size and object-fit:cover within the bounded thumbnail
Keep the existing card grid, device name, connection method/code, note, time, arrow, detail link and deletion button
Retain custom/default wallpaper sharing and the 116x76, 96x64 and 88x60 thumbnail dimensions
